application.source: classification mapping required by the facts audit brief

chemistry.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16868546, vehicle names LFP01, NMC01 and NMC02 in the release

units_released.note: Rule: the field vehicles with raw segments; feature-only vehicles and laboratory cells are not units. Released unit identifiers require package-specific inspection.

cells_liion.source: cell-voltage columns of the four field vehicles' converted segments (LFP01 123, NMC01_Car01 107, NMC01_Car02 108, NMC02 94), through fielddata.loaders.tongji_rest

cells_leadacid.note: No lead-acid cell count applies or is exposed in this release.

cell_channels_measured.source: cell-voltage columns of the four field vehicles' converted segments (LFP01 123, NMC01_Car01 107, NMC01_Car02 108, NMC02 94), through fielddata.loaders.tongji_rest

energy_mwh.note: Present usable energy computed from the data: coulomb counting over runs of at least 40 points of SOC with no gap over 300 s, ampere-hours per 100 percent SOC times mean pack voltage, median per unit, summed.

energy_basis.source: energy_mwh is computed from the released data

span_unit_years.note: unit-years is first to last segment time of each of the 4 field vehicles, summed; 83 feature-only vehicles and 28 laboratory cells are held but not units

obs_hours.note: Calendar spans are measurable, so observation-hours are not used.

fault_onset_timestamp.source: docs/descriptor/TABLE3_faults.md; released labels and metadata contain no explicit fault-onset timestamp field

sentinels_documented.source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16868546; public data record and released documentation state no sentinel convention
